messages:
Lila: Heads up 1: planning the April product newsletter + webinar push. Need final segment defs and webhook field map before I lock the send tomorrow.

Omar: Quick audience numbers: total newsletter list ~42k, active product trial pool ~9.6k, recent eng users (last 14d) ~2.2k. We should consider a VIP segment for power users.

Sam: I like 4 segments for tailoring:
- VIP power users: invited + concierge seat (single high-touch email).
- Engaged trials: short invite + RSVP button (1 email).
- Passive trials: 3-step nurture with tips leading to webinar (3 emails).
- Cold list: teaser + replay-only (1 email, later).

Nico: Timing recs: US morning sends staggered by timezone (PST 9am, EST 11am). EU batch midday (UTC 13:00). APAC minimal send, but schedule for 9am local the following day. Holdback: 7% per segment for baseline.

Lila: Subject line experiments? Need 3 variants: curiosity, metric, and tactical.

Sam: Variant 1: "Live: How teams shave inference cost without accuracy loss"
Sam: Variant 2: "See the benchmark1: 2x throughput, 30% less cost"
Sam: Variant 3: "3 practical batching tricks to lower token bills"

Omar: Preheader ideas: short stat, speaker + time, and CTA (register free). Also include personalization: {{first_name}} where appropriate.

Lila: Routing to SFDC: all signups should create or update Lead/Contact + join Campaign "Apr-Webinar-2026". We must include source, segment, ab_variant, holdback_flag, and mail_id. Who owns the payload?

Nico: ops-bot will proxy form -> webhook -> sf-sync-bot. Fields we'll push: Email, Name, Company, Campaign, ListSegment, AB_Variant, HoldbackFlag, MailId, UTM. Also include opt_in_consent flag for GDPR.

Lila: Can we get a sample payload for Sales Ops? Need it inline for the runbook.

sf-sync-bot: Sample payload ready. Use this JSON minimal example:

`{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "name": "{{first_name}} {{last_name}}",
  "company": "{{company}}",
  "campaign": "Apr-Webinar-2026",
  "utm_source": "newsletter",
  "segment": "VIP|Engaged|Passive|Cold",
  "ab_variant": "1|2|3",
  "holdback": "true|false",
  "mail_id": "NL-2026-04-01",
  "consent": "true|false"
}`

Sam: Also tag Pardot with "newsletter_apr_webinar" in email_tags for downstream automation.

ops-bot: Confirmed. Webhook will POST to sf-sync-bot endpoint. When created, a duplicate check will run on Email and Company, and then SFDC upsert will occur. I'll log the raw payload to S3 path: s3://redwood-ops/newsletter/apr2026/payloads for audit.

Nico: For analytics: capture register timestamp, segment, ab_variant, and holdback in event stream (kinesis). We'll map those to Pardot fields for attribution.

Lila: One more ask: we need a short fallback content variant for customers behind corporate filters (strip images, plain text). Can MarketingOps provide a plain text template?

Omar: I'll draft a plain text fallback and send in the doc. Also prepping copy for the 3-email cadence (tips -> case study -> webinar CTA).

Sam: Action checklist:
- Nico: deploy webhook + S3 logging (today).
- sf-sync-bot: confirm SFDC CampaignId and test upsert (by 3pm).
- Omar: finalize subject/preheader variants + plain text fallback (by noon).
- Lila: approve segment queries and schedule (4pm).

Lila: If we hit all of that, I'll schedule the send and enable the 7% holdback. Thanks team. :rocket:
